summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY agent with full-host RCE surface
details: The @ai-support-agent/cli package installs a daemon that connects to a remote API server (default api.ai-support-agent.com) and executes commands the server sends on the installer's machine. In dist/api-client.js and related modules, executeShellCommand spawns `/bin/sh -c <payload.command>` where the command string is taken from the getCommand/pending-commands API response. dist/vscode/vscode-server.js and the browser/local server implement a TerminalWebSocket whose handleStdin writes base64-decoded WebSocket payloads directly into a PTY session. The result is full-host remote code execution driven by whoever controls the paired server or holds the agent's auth token. dist/cli/service/darwin-service.js and dist/cli/service/linux-service.js provide a `service install` subcommand that registers the daemon as a launchd/systemd unit so it runs on boot, extending persistence of the remote-execution channel. The remote-command channel is the package's advertised purpose, but the trust boundary of the installed host reduces to the security of the remote server and the agent token: any compromise of either yields full-host RCE and persistent shell access to every machine running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
